compiled_state.title: [tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh]: SIGPIPE on echo|grep -q pipeline pattern
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Background

Split from umbrella bug 53f9-a218-8799-49be (closed as superseded). This ticket covers Track C.

## Symptom

`tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh` fails intermittently with SIGPIPE. Around line 95 of the test there is a comment indicating the author was already aware that an `echo | grep -q` pipeline pattern was a source of SIGPIPE flakiness, but it is not clear from the current test code whether that pattern has actually been fully eliminated.

## Investigation findings (BASIC tier, recorded on 53f9 during P2 triage)

The `echo | grep -q ...` pattern is SIGPIPE-vulnerable: `grep -q` exits early on first match (with success), which closes the pipe; if `echo`'s next write attempt happens after grep has exited, echo receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline as a whole reports failure under `set -o pipefail`.

## Proposed approach

1. Audit tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh for any remaining `echo|grep -q` (or equivalent `printf|grep -q`) patterns.
2. Replace each with a SIGPIPE-safe equivalent: either `grep -q ... <<<"$value"` (here-string) or an explicit `echo ... | { grep -q ...; rc=$?; cat >/dev/null; exit $rc; }` form that drains the pipe.
3. Reference fix-pattern: prior work in commit 4ff92a31fa addressed the same anti-pattern across the test suite.

## Affected files

* tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh

## References

* Umbrella ticket: 53f9-a218-8799-49be (closed as superseded)
* Related prior fix: commit 4ff92a31fa (replace SIGPIPE-vulnerable echo|grep -q patterns in test suite)
